redistribution_classes.meaning: AGID-created metadata and non-geographic fixtures only.
Public official pages used as pinned validation receipts; access does not imply bulk redistribution rights.
A provider-approved release whose license, attribution, schema, validity, and redistribution terms are pinned.
Licensed postal, address, or cadastral data kept outside public artifacts unless contract review explicitly permits release.
Third-party or unclear-rights data may detect discrepancies but cannot become public authoritative geometry.

sources.production_scope: Pinned permitted search receipts or contract release retaining query, result class, locality, capture time, source version, rights, and digest.
Pinned UPU addressing guide used for syntax and presentation rules only.

sources.provider: State Service on Property Issues, Ministry of Economy
sources.production_scope: Only provider-approved public fields from a pinned URIS/Address Portal release or receipt; protected real-estate register data remains excluded.

sources.provider: State Service on Property Issues, Ministry of Economy
sources.production_scope: Provider-approved public cadastral fields and geometry only, pinned by object identifier, status, release, CRS, rights, and digest.
Dataset-by-dataset review only; each artifact pins the actual publisher, license, schema, update date, coverage, and digest.

artifact_partitions.rule: Azərpoçt evidence retains query or product, edition, record class, locality, capture time, rights, and digest; licensed rows never silently enter public artifacts.
ÜRIS address assertions retain official object identity, hierarchy, status, coordinates when published, release, rights, and postal cross-check status.
Cadastral identity and geometry remain distinct from an address until a common official identifier or reviewed crosswalk proves the link.
Rights-cleared address membership may generate a versioned, uncertainty-bearing derived surface; method and boundary clips remain reproducible and the result is never official geometry.
Source jurisdiction and validity are retained; components are not bridged across exclaves, borders, gaps, or disputed classifications, and postal evidence never determines sovereignty.
Recipients, residents, owners, occupants, phones, credentials, title records, precise private entrances, and protected register fields never enter public artifacts.
Non-geographic fixture metadata only; never promotion evidence.
